name: Smoke
desc: Smoke crossing the frame with real curl — puffs are advected through a divergence-free curl-noise field, so they roll and shear into tendrils instead of just sliding, growing and going translucent as they climb away from the source at x/y; sits mid-frame at any height rather than banking along the floor.

energy.doc: curl strength, buoyancy and opacity — how violently it rolls

scale.doc: puff size and curl cell size vs design size

wind.doc: lateral draught carrying the plume across (negative blows left)

hue.doc: smoke hue (210 cool grey, 30 warm woodsmoke, 275 stage haze)

x.doc: source X — put it off-frame to have smoke drift in from outside

y.doc: source Y — 0.95 sits the seat of it just off the bottom

style.doc: aesthetic: soft grey volumetric rolls with a lit rim / a thin thread that stays laminar then breaks into turbulence as it rises / dark bleeding sumi tendrils dispersing in water / the advection field itself as a vector diagram, no smoke at all

act.doc: dramaturgy: steady plume / the source pumps out billows with the musical arc / thins away and re-thickens over minutes
